caseName: State Tax Commission v. Herzog Bros. Trucking, Inc.
caseNameFull: State Tax Commission of the State of New York v. Herzog Brothers Trucking, Inc., aka Herzog Brothers, Inc.

opinions.text: Ct. App. N. Y. Motion of Seneca Nation of Indians for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae denied. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of proposed regulations formally published for comment by the Commissioner of Taxation and Finance of the State of New York on March 8, 1988.
